en.headline: Police search Diamond Hill after report of woman with a knife
en.dek: Officers were told a woman was seen with a fruit knife near Diamond Hill station. RTHK said a search around Tsz Ching Estate had found no one.
body: Police were searching the Diamond Hill area on Sunday evening after a report that a woman had been seen with a knife, RTHK reported. No arrest had been announced.

RTHK said police received a report at about 6:50pm from staff at MTR Diamond Hill station that a woman was suspected of carrying a fruit knife. Officers searched the area and reviewed closed-circuit television. The footage indicated she was last seen around Tsz Ching Estate in Tsz Wan Shan, the broadcaster reported.

Police were still searching nearby and had not found her, RTHK said at 9:25pm. The case was classified as a report of a suspicious person. Other outlets reported that counter-terrorism response officers had searched Plaza Hollywood with shields and that an emergency unit later attended Tsz Ching Estate. Those accounts were not confirmed in the RTHK report.
Police had not named anyone. The woman has not been charged.

zh.headline: 鑽石山報稱有女子持刀 警方搜索暫無發現
zh.dek: 警方接獲港鐵鑽石山站職員報案，指一名女子疑持生果刀。港台稱閉路電視顯示她最後在慈正邨一帶出現，搜索暫未尋獲。
body: 香港電台報道，星期日傍晚鑽石山有人報稱一名女子疑似持刀，警方到場搜索。警方暫未公布有人被捕。
港台稱，晚上約6時50分，警方接獲港鐵鑽石山站職員報案，指發現一名女子懷疑手持一把生果刀。警員到場搜查並翻查閉路電視，畫面顯示該名女子最後在慈雲山慈正邨一帶出現。
港台在晚上9時25分報道，警方仍在附近搜索，暫時未有發現，案件列作「可疑人發現」處理。其他報道指反恐特勤隊曾持盾在荷里活廣場內搜索，東九龍衝鋒隊其後到慈正邨了解，這些細節未見於港台的報道。
警方沒有公布涉事女子姓名。她並未被落案起訴。
